description: Design §13 Yaran-Refusal header codes (kebab-case, never reused). A 401/403 without the header came from Access, not yaran. access-keys-unavailable is a server problem; any other access-* means sign in again; host-* means the machine is no longer connected.

refusals.meaning: Not a 3-segment JWT, bad base64url or JSON, or over 8 KiB.
alg is not exactly RS256, or no kid.
kid absent from the JWKS after one refetch.
iss is not the team domain.
aud lacks the machine app's AUD.
nbf is in the future (with skew).
A service-token JWT (no email, empty sub, or common_name).
email is not the paired owner_email.
JWKS unreachable and nothing cached; signing in will not help.
Host is not bound (cloudflared outlived its binding).
